title: I have decided
lyrics_original: I have decided to follow Jesus;
I have decided to follow Jesus;
I have decided to follow Jesus;
No turning back, no turning back.
The world behind me, the cross before me;
The world behind me, the cross before me;
The world behind me, the cross before me;
No turning back, no turning back.
Though none go with me, still I will follow;
Though none go with me, still I will follow;
Though none go with me, still I will follow;
No turning back, no turning back.
My cross I’ll carry, till I see Jesus;
My cross I’ll carry, till I see Jesus;
My cross I’ll carry, till I see Jesus;
No turning back, no turning back.
Will you decide now to follow Jesus?
Will you decide now to follow Jesus?
Will you decide now to follow Jesus?
No turning back, no turning back.

bible_verses.telugu: మరియు ఆయన అందరితో ఇట్లనెను        ఎవడైనను నన్ను వెంబడింప గోరినయెడల తన్నుతాను ఉపేక్షించుకొని, ప్రతిదినము తన సిలువను ఎత్తికొని          నన్ను వెంబడింపవలెను.
bible_verses.english: Then he said to them all: 'Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.'

bible_verses.telugu: యేసునాగటిమీద చెయ్యిపెట్టి వెనుకతట్టు చూచు వాడెవడును దేవుని రాజ్యమునకు పాత్రుడుకాడని వానితో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: Jesus replied, 'No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God.'

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే మన ప్రభువైన యేసుక్రీస్తు సిలువయందు తప్ప మరి దేనియందును అతిశయించుట నాకు దూరమవును గాక; దానివలన నాకు లోకమును లోకమునకు నేనును సిలువవేయబడి
bible_verses.english: May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for calling me into a life of following Jesus. When distractions lure my eyes away or loneliness weighs on my spirit, fix my gaze upon Your cross. Give me courage to take each step forward in faith, resting fully in Your unfailing love. Keep my heart steadfast, knowing that walking with You is my greatest joy. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for calling me into a life of following Jesus. When distractions lure my eyes away or loneliness weighs on my spirit, fix my gaze upon Your cross. Give me courage to take each step forward in faith, resting fully in Your unfailing love. Keep my heart steadfast, knowing that walking with You is my greatest joy. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Deciding to follow Jesus is a quiet, profound act of surrender that transforms our whole lives. When we declare 'no turning back,' we anchor our hearts in His grace rather than our own strength. Even when the road feels lonely or uncertain, the light of the cross before us assures us that Christ walks every step alongside us. Today, let this gentle refrain remind you that stepping forward with Jesus is always worth the journey.
